Phone rows: the C++ runner on LiteRT 2.3.0's C API (one process per run; the host's inputs computed on the Mac), the run records with their run directories (input list, read-back, setup, clock samples). The line (pre-registered): against the reference (the source model's inference.py, float32 CPU, one thread), the winner equal on every question whose reference top two are more than 0.02 apart, max |Δp| <= 0.02, mean |Δp| <= 0.002, the control above 0.02 where the file holds it, the hidden state finite; on a phone the winner also equals the same file's on the Mac CPU, on an NPU one partition holds every op; a runtime passes on a device only when it passes on every file it ran (metrics arm_files_run / arm_files_passed). output_match stays null: the line is against that reference, not the shared element tolerance against a CPU run of the same bytes. The Pixel 11 Pro's GPU at FP16_WITH_FP32_ACCUM, at FP16 and with no precision set does not pass on this phone and has no record.
